# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.5 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.4`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Aligns the Cloud sign-in and organization finder with Carbon’s responsive grid and spacing scale.

## User and administrator impact

- Sign-in providers, the organization finder form and alternate entry links share the same alignment on desktop and mobile.
- Email and organization-name errors appear after pressing Continue, leaving the alternate entry actions available while switching.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Documentation

- The existing Cloud organization finder uses Carbon Grid, Column, Tile and Stack components.
